name: maybe_GameWork_FindEntryByNameHash
signature: int maybe_GameWork_FindEntryByNameHash(int self, const char* name, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
summary: Looks up an entry by name in a list owned by the object behind game work+8 -> +0xB4: returns self+4 for the empty name, otherwise hashes the name (Str_HashName) and returns the first list element (array f_3644, count f_3648) whose +0x1C equals the hash, or 0.
evidence: Body: func_0010540C empty-name test, Str_HashName(0,name), linear scan comparing result->f_1c with the hash. Nothing in the body or callers ties it to debugging, so the Debug_ prefix was dropped; what the list holds is still unknown.

name: maybe_Party_FindListIndexOfNode
signature: u32 maybe_Party_FindListIndexOfNode(u32 arg1, int node, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)

evidence: Re-read: `result` is only incremented once per outer iteration and is returned unchanged from the inner node loop, so it is the list (slot) index, not a cumulative ordinal as the first pass said. Four lists match the party-group layout used by Party_FindMemberOrdinalInSlot.

name: maybe_Casino_Poker_DealHandB
summary: Poker deal variant: reshuffles the rank (f_82..) and suit (f_8f..) orders, then swaps hand slots f_17.. with the deck entries for (rank[i], suit[j]) looked up via func_00416638, a fixed pattern of exchanges.
evidence: Same Casino_Poker_ShuffleDeck13/ShuffleDeck4 + func_00416638 swap pattern as its siblings; which game mode or rigging uses this variant is not visible.

name: maybe_Casino_Poker_SwapTenSlots
summary: Poker deal variant that swaps ten (rank,suit) deck entries into the hand slots in pairs after reshuffling the rank and suit orders.
evidence: Ten CONCAT11(rank,suit) lookups through func_00416638; sibling of the other DealHand variants. Purpose of this particular variant unknown.

name: maybe_Casino_Poker_DealHandF
summary: Poker deal variant: random rotation of five rank entries (modulo 9 / 5 rolls from the game RNG at work+8 -> +0x98) followed by the shared slot-swap sequence.
evidence: func_0051B1FC(rng,0x7fffffff) + func_0011CD80(...,9) and the same swap pattern; variant purpose unknown.

name: Field_ModelSlotEmitter_Configure
signature: u32 Field_ModelSlotEmitter_Configure(ModelSlotSet* self, Vec3* pos, Vec3* rot, Appearance* appearance, int slotRef, int slotIndex, int arg7)
summary: Configures one render slot of a field model-slot emitter: copies the 0x84-byte appearance record, position/rotation vectors, colour and owner into the 0xB8-byte record of the shared slot array (work+0x24A98), then extends the set's child list. Returns 1.
evidence: Re-read with the named neighbour maybe_Field_ModelSlotEmitter_ReleaseSlots, which frees exactly these 0xB8 records (same array func_00192F78(work+0x24A98), same owner field self->f_268); memcpy of 0x84 bytes into slot+4 matches.

name: Field_ModelSlotEmitter_ReleaseSlots
summary: Releases the emitter's slots: for each child actor whose slot index points at a 0xB8 record owned by this set (owner f_268, variant bytes +0x7E/+0x7F) it resets the record to the free state and detaches the actor.
evidence: Mirror of Field_ModelSlotEmitter_Configure: same slot array and owner check; zeroes the 0x84 appearance block via func_00116AE0.

name: maybe_Gfx_CreateRegularShakeWork
summary: Allocates a 0x94-byte named work object (Container_NameHash_CtorB, vtable 0x0077D8A4), stores five float parameters and the slot byte, and inserts it into the named map at game work+8 -> +0x74.

name: Sound_SceneBgmTrigger_Update
summary: Per-frame update of a scene-BGM trigger on a 2D object: accumulates dt; after 1 s switches to state 1, and after a further 0.4 s with the trigger touched resolves the scene BGM id (Snd_ResolveSceneBgmId) and commits it (Snd_CommitPendingBgmId).
evidence: Named callees Snd_ResolveSceneBgmId / Snd_CommitPendingBgmId and Field_Object2D_UpdateTouchState; thresholds 0x3F7FFFFF (~1.0) and 0x3ECCCCCD (0.4).

name: maybe_Ui_Entry_GetIconId

name: maybe_Gfx_SpriteNode_EmitBurstOnEvent

name: maybe_Battle_RollResistanceChance
summary: Chance roll against a unit's resistance class: looks up the target's record (id arg2->f_76c), maps its class byte f_CE (0..6) to a weight 1/8/16/32/64/128/256, combines it with the attacker's f_3EC value and a random roll (Math_RandomChanceBelow on the battle RNG), returns whether it succeeds; class out of range = false.
evidence: The body is a probability computation (weight table + Math_RandomChanceBelow), nothing about message rows or blinking; f_CE/f_CF look like per-unit resistance class bytes. Kept as maybe_ because the stat meaning is not confirmed.
